messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Mesh creation
parts:
Hi Rujia,

I have been working on this topic extensively!

I have written a paper on this "bias" (the imact of the coastline), see
https://arxiv.org/abs/1608.03787
and the code examples at
https://haakonbakka.bitbucket.io/btopic107.html

However, to correct for this coastline problem, you will need a slightly more detailed mesh. It does not have to follow the coastline perfectly, but it still needs a higher resolution than what you are using. This will take significantly more time to compute than using the mesh you have attached. The mesh you have attached would be considered too coarse also in the stationary case.

Kind regards,
Haakon
